text:
Maria Chen: Quick bench from last night's bring-up of llama3-small (int8). Ran on h100 / a100 in us-east, us-west, eu-west. Posting p50/p95 + a couple kernel configs. Need routing guidance for canary rollout.

perf-bot: Automated job finished: job-id 2026-04-04-llama3-int8. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1712467800/

Alex Kim: Can you paste the p50/p95 snapshot here?

Priya Nair: Sure — raw numbers (ms) from 5000 calls per region, sequence typical=128 tokens, batching=auto:
```
region   | gpu  | kernel              | p50  | p95
---------+------+---------------------+------+-----
us-east  | h100 | fused-attn-v2       | 46ms | 118ms
us-east  | a100 | matmul-opt          | 60ms | 190ms
us-west  | h100 | fused-attn-v2       | 50ms | 140ms
us-west  | a100 | matmul-opt          | 66ms | 215ms
eu-west  | h100 | fused-attn-v2       | 68ms | 250ms
eu-west  | a100 | matmul-opt          | 82ms | 320ms
```

Alex Kim: yikes eu-west p95 is high on both. Is that network egress / edge route?

Priya Nair: We saw higher hop count to eu-west free-proxy layer. Trace from us-east->eu-west shows extra proxy hop (edge-router-3) adding ~50ms tail occasionally.

Dan O'Connor: @Priya did you try forcing direct-pop routing for eu-west canary? Might reduce p95.

Priya Nair: Yes — direct-pop test dropped eu-west p95 to ~180ms on h100 but increased us-east p95 slightly for routed traffic on that instance. So there's a tradeoff.

Maria Chen: How about throughput/capacity? Did int8 on h100 let us consolidate capacity?

Priya Nair: Throughput at p50-sla: h100 int8 ~ 1.8x of a100 int8 for this model. Capacity estimate: for target 1000 rps steady, need 6 h100 nodes in us-east vs 10 a100.

Alex Kim: Any quality regressions from int8?

Priya Nair: Small: ROUGE drop ~2.5% on our prompt set; logprob shift noticed but below alert threshold. Recommend running aligned evals in rollout.

Maria Chen: So routing policy suggestion?

Alex Kim: Proposal: keep default routing by latency (auto) but add region-specific fallthrough to direct-pop for eu-west canaries; prefer h100 for p95-sensitive routes. Also enable KV prefix cache to reduce p50.

Dan O'Connor: I'll add a temporary routing rule and monitor p95 for 24h. @perf-bot can you schedule daily p50/p95 snapshot at 00:00 UTC for next 3 days?

perf-bot: Scheduled: daily-latency-snapshot starting 1712554200 (24h). Reports to #eng-ml.

Maria Chen: Thanks — will prepare rollout doc with kernel notes (fused-attn-v2 preferred on h100, matmul-opt fallback on a100). Will also attach eval ACL.

Alex Kim: LGTM. Let's keep watch on eu-west tail.
